SELECT n.notice_id, n.title, n.content, n.emp_id, e.empno AS empno, CASE WHEN n.title LIKE UNISTR('%\D488\C9C8%') THEN UNISTR('\D488\C9C8\BD80\C11C') WHEN n.title LIKE UNISTR('%\C124\BE44%') THEN UNISTR('\C124\BE44\BD80\C11C') WHEN n.title LIKE UNISTR('%\C7AC\ACE0%') OR n.title LIKE UNISTR('%\BB3C\B958%') THEN UNISTR('\BB3C\B958\BD80\C11C') WHEN n.title LIKE UNISTR('%\C0DD\C0B0%') THEN UNISTR('\C0DD\C0B0\BD80\C11C') WHEN n.title LIKE UNISTR('%\C2DC\C5F0%') OR n.title LIKE UNISTR('%\B370\C774\D130%') THEN UNISTR('MES\0020\AD00\B9AC\C790') WHEN e.dept = 'MES' THEN UNISTR('MES\0020\AD00\B9AC\C790') ELSE e.dept || UNISTR('\BD80\C11C') END AS dept, n.view_count, TO_CHAR(n.created_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS created_date, TO_CHAR(n.updated_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS updated_date, n.status, n.use_yn, n.remark FROM notice n, emp e WHERE n.emp_id = e.emp_id AND NVL(n.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y'
AND TRUNC(n.created_date) >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND TRUNC(n.created_date) <= TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND ( n.title LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR n.content LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR e.dept LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR CASE WHEN n.title LIKE UNISTR('%\D488\C9C8%') THEN UNISTR('\D488\C9C8\BD80\C11C') WHEN n.title LIKE UNISTR('%\C124\BE44%') THEN UNISTR('\C124\BE44\BD80\C11C') WHEN n.title LIKE UNISTR('%\C7AC\ACE0%') OR n.title LIKE UNISTR('%\BB3C\B958%') THEN UNISTR('\BB3C\B958\BD80\C11C') WHEN n.title LIKE UNISTR('%\C0DD\C0B0%') THEN UNISTR('\C0DD\C0B0\BD80\C11C') WHEN n.title LIKE UNISTR('%\C2DC\C5F0%') OR n.title LIKE UNISTR('%\B370\C774\D130%') THEN UNISTR('MES\0020\AD00\B9AC\C790') WHEN e.dept = 'MES' THEN UNISTR('MES\0020\AD00\B9AC\C790') ELSE e.dept || UNISTR('\BD80\C11C') END LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY n.notice_id DESC

SELECT n.notice_id, n.title, n.content, n.emp_id, e.empno AS empno, CASE WHEN n.title LIKE UNISTR('%\D488\C9C8%') THEN UNISTR('\D488\C9C8\BD80\C11C') WHEN n.title LIKE UNISTR('%\C124\BE44%') THEN UNISTR('\C124\BE44\BD80\C11C') WHEN n.title LIKE UNISTR('%\C7AC\ACE0%') OR n.title LIKE UNISTR('%\BB3C\B958%') THEN UNISTR('\BB3C\B958\BD80\C11C') WHEN n.title LIKE UNISTR('%\C0DD\C0B0%') THEN UNISTR('\C0DD\C0B0\BD80\C11C') WHEN n.title LIKE UNISTR('%\C2DC\C5F0%') OR n.title LIKE UNISTR('%\B370\C774\D130%') THEN UNISTR('MES\0020\AD00\B9AC\C790') WHEN e.dept = 'MES' THEN UNISTR('MES\0020\AD00\B9AC\C790') ELSE e.dept || UNISTR('\BD80\C11C') END AS dept, n.view_count, TO_CHAR(n.created_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS created_date, TO_CHAR(n.updated_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS updated_date, n.status, n.use_yn, n.remark FROM notice n, emp e WHERE n.emp_id = e.emp_id AND n.notice_id = TO_NUMBER(#{notice_id})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice ( notice_id, title, content, emp_id, view_count, created_date, updated_date, status, use_yn, remark ) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX(notice_id), 0) + 1 FROM notice), #{title}, #{content}, (SELECT e.emp_id FROM emp e WHERE e.empno = #{empno}), 0, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, #{status}, 'Y', #{remark} )
mapper.update: UPDATE notice SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, updated_date = SYSDATE WHERE notice_id = TO_NUMBER(#{notice_id})

UPDATE notice n SET n.view_count = NVL(n.view_count, 0) + 1 WHERE n.notice_id = TO_NUMBER(#{notice_id})
AND n.emp_id != ( SELECT e.emp_id FROM emp e WHERE e.empno = #{empno} )
mapper.delete:
